limits: One finite synthetic Graph is not a complete Apple model/MTP quality or performance result.
The probe covers ordinary GDN output_scale; prior direct tests separately cover recurrent raw gates and inference-domain rejection.
No Vulkan/Orin or other unrun backend is covered. No new throughput/memory claim.
